description.p: Ferrite is a fast, native markdown editor with live preview, syntax highlighting, and native Mermaid diagram rendering. Built with Rust and egui for excellent performance.

ul.li: Three view modes: Raw editing, Split view, and full WYSIWYG preview
Native Mermaid diagram rendering (flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, pie charts, and more)
CSV/TSV viewer with rainbow column coloring and sorting
JSON/YAML/TOML tree viewer with collapsible nodes
Git integration with visual status indicators in file tree
Workspace mode with file tree navigation
Find and replace with regex support
Synchronized scrolling between editor and preview
Customizable syntax highlighting themes (25+ themes)
Dark and light application themes
Zen mode for distraction-free writing
Multi-language interface support
Multi-encoding file support with auto-detection

screenshot.caption: Ferrite in dark mode with split view showing markdown editing and live preview
Raw editing mode with syntax highlighting

description.p: YouTube embeds, multi-window editing, a Mermaid second wave, and search-first Settings.

ul.li: Inline YouTube playback in the rendered preview. On Linux the thumbnail opens the video in the browser.
Multiple document windows, restored with the session
Mermaid git graphs, diagram popup, fit-to-preview, sequence autonumber, and smooth link curves
CSV cell editing, GFM table alignment, and a GitHub HTML subset
Search-first Settings, optional spellcheck, and separate rendered and terminal fonts
Preview lock, reload from disk, CRLF preserved on edit and save, and clipboard image paste
Encoding switches and legacy-encoding saves no longer drop or mangle text

description.p: Major platform refresh on egui 0.34.2 with export, WYSIWYG editing, and Mermaid improvements.

ul.li: Native PDF export, print preview, and themed HTML export
Executable fenced code blocks (Run/Stop, opt-in with consent)
Rendered edit session: one-click WYSIWYG block switching for headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables
Split-view scroll sync (Sync / 2-way) and user-configurable Ferrite accent color
Mermaid: insert toolbar, inline validation, flowchart routing/layout polish, state fork/join
Full-workspace file index for Ctrl+P and Search in Files
Hardened session recovery (path + disk-hash identity)
Phosphor icons across UI; Spanish language; quick note workflow (on by default)
Platform: egui/eframe 0.34.2, Rust 1.92 MSRV

description.p: Hotfix release for four critical v0.2.8 regressions. No new features.

ul.li: Fixed crash in Split / Rendered view when opening an empty document (#127)
Fixed missing unsaved-changes indicator and missing save prompt on close (data loss)
Fixed broken Undo / Redo — "Nothing to undo" after typing
Fixed invisible text selection in Light mode (#121)
Widened document side panel default so the Outline / Stats / Links / FM / Hub tabs no longer overlap

description.p: Performance, text shaping, command palette, and bug fixes

ul.li: Command Palette (Alt+Space) — searchable launcher for all actions with fuzzy search
HarfRust text shaping for Arabic, Bengali, Devanagari, and other complex scripts
Image viewer tabs (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP) with zoom and metadata
PDF viewer tabs using hayro (pure Rust PDF renderer)
Rendered view performance: AST caching, viewport culling, lazy block estimation
Per-frame O(N) elimination for large files, background file loading for 5MB+ files
Strict line breaks setting for Obsidian-style newline handling
Middle-click to close tabs
Fixed custom font crash on Linux, macOS .md file association, 10+ bug fixes

description.p: Major feature release: wikilinks, callouts, Vim mode, new packaging formats, and performance improvements

ul.li: Wikilinks and backlinks panel for knowledge-base workflows
GitHub-style callouts (NOTE, TIP, WARNING, CAUTION, IMPORTANT)
Vim mode with Normal/Insert/Visual modes and essential commands
Ctrl+Scroll wheel zoom and keyboard zoom (Ctrl++/Ctrl+-/Ctrl+0)
Single-instance protocol: files open as tabs in existing window
Visual frontmatter editor panel for YAML metadata
Welcome page on first run with configuration wizard
Lazy font loading for 11 complex script families (Arabic, Hebrew, Devanagari, Thai, and more)
Lazy CSV/TSV row parsing for large files (memory reduced from ~200MB to ~8MB for 1M rows)
Check for Updates button in Settings
New packaging: Linux .deb and .rpm, macOS .app bundles (ARM64 + Intel), Nix flake, PortableApps.com
MSI installer with file associations, Explorer context menu, and PATH integration
Fixed word wrap scroll correctness, binary file crash, IME backspace, Linux portal dialogs

description.p: First code-signed release with integrated terminal, productivity hub, and bug fixes

ul.li: Integrated terminal workspace with tiling, splitting, and layout persistence
Productivity hub panel for quick-access editing tasks
Windows code signing via SignPath Foundation (no more SmartScreen warnings)
App.rs refactored into ~15 focused modules
Tab drag reorder and file watcher auto-reload
CJK font lazy loading reduces startup memory by ~80MB
Fixed CJK font crash on startup and portable Windows startup crash
Fixed duplicate line, smart paste, drag-drop positioning, and 5+ other bugs
CJK first-line paragraph indentation for Chinese and Japanese

description.p: Major release: Custom text editor (FerriteEditor) replacing egui's TextEdit

ul.li: Virtual scrolling enables 100MB+ file editing
Memory optimization: 80MB file uses ~80MB RAM (was 460MB+)
Rope-based buffer for O(log n) text operations
Full selection, clipboard, undo/redo support
IME support for Chinese, Japanese, Korean input
Code folding and multi-cursor editing
Navigation buttons (Top/Middle/Bottom)
Box drawing character support

description.p: UI improvements, extended syntax support, Linux performance fixes, and Flathub submission

ul.li: View mode segmented control (Raw/Split/Rendered)
100+ additional language syntaxes
25+ syntax highlighting themes
Fixed Linux folder opening freeze
Fixed blockquote/table overflow
Flathub desktop and metainfo files

description.p: Editor shortcuts, macOS improvements, Linux fixes, i18n cleanup

ul.li: Delete Line shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+D)
Move Line Up/Down (Alt+Up/Down)
macOS file type associations
Windows portable build and MSI installer
Linux RPM package
Fixed Ctrl+X cutting entire document bug
Fixed Linux window drag stuck mouse
Added Estonian and Norwegian Bokmål translations
Tiered idle repaint system reducing CPU usage
Multi-encoding file support with auto-detection
CJK font lazy loading for reduced memory usage
Improved cursor positioning in rendered view
Fixed 10% idle CPU usage

description.p: Major feature release with Mermaid diagrams and workspace improvements
